source.title: [Armored Core 6] Season 17 Ranked Match Livestream
source.platform: unknown (not stated in title; not visually verifiable)
source.overlay_status: no overlay (all 628 ten-second thumbnails show the full game frame; no stream graphics)
source.locale_note: Korean UI: the final banner words are English but drawn in a plain rounded sans typeface, visibly different from the stylised banner typeface of the Japanese-UI sources (seen on the 1080p verification crops)

coverage.structure: 1 fps 64x36 thumbnails for 0-6274 s; lobby segments by correlation with reference lobby seconds 100,470,760 (>=0.90) used only as an aid; all 628 ten-second contact thumbnails reviewed visually and 20 matches delimited from them
coverage.interval_ends: 20 of 20 match ends reviewed as 2 fps central-band strips (35-50 s windows around each end)
coverage.status: complete structural coverage; all 20 events second-verified on the 1080p60 copy
coverage.verification_method: native 1080p60 (format 299) central-band crop at each banner midpoint: 19/20 legible and matching; YB-15 midpoint fell on a flicker dip and was verified on a 10 fps 1080p strip (YOU LOSE 4790.6-4793.5 s, dip at 4792.8 s)
coverage.known_annotation_limits: 2 fps strip labels can lead the shown frame by up to ~0.3 s; bounds are +/-0.5 s
